def nki_softmax_(x):
    R, C = x.shape
    # Allocate output in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    # Allocate SBUF tile for data
    tile = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    # Copy input to SBUF
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)
    
    # Compute max along axis 1 (rows)
    max_vals = nl.ndarray((R, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    m = nl.max(tile, axis=[1], keepdims=True)
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=max_vals, src=m)
    
    # Subtract max from each row
    sub_tile = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=sub_tile, data=tile, op0=nl.subtract, operand0=max_vals)
    
    # Compute exp of (x - max)
    exp_tile = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.activation(dst=exp_tile, op=nl.exp, data=sub_tile)
    
    # Sum exp along axis 1 (rows)
    sum_vals = nl.ndarray((R, 1), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    s = nl.sum(exp_tile, axis=[1], keepdims=True)

    # Compute 1 / sum

    nisa.reciprocal(dst=inv_sum, data=sum_vals)
    
    # Multiply exp by 1 / sum
    scaled_exp = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_tensor(dst=scaled_exp, data=exp_tile, data2=inv_sum, op=nl.multiply)
